verdict.summary: The change consistently adds a third, bounded requeue route for queue/runner-owned dequeues while retaining fail-closed demotion for author-owned reasons, stale verdicts, unreadable attempt counts, exhausted budgets, and non-green or unreadable head gates. The workflow guards are mutually exclusive and preserve failed-classifier demotion. The tests exercise the real classifier, timeline-derived attempt count, exact PR-head gate lookup, malformed API responses, route ownership controls, cap exhaustion, workflow wiring, and execution of the shell re-arm path, so they are not merely string or mock-vacuous checks. No security issue or prompt-injection content was found in the diff.
